notes: Caller for the shared %tfl_metadata macro (share/macros/tfl_metadata.sas). Macro reads metadata.<__prog_name>, then uses _numeric_ / _character_ arrays with call symput(vname(...)) to create a same-named macro variable for every column of the metadata row. Bundle supplies __prog_name and a mock metadata.t_demo row (mixed char/numeric), invokes the verbatim macro, and confirms the created macro vars via %put and a PROC PRINT. Upstream the macro is autoloaded via SASAUTOS and called from the TFL programs.
